newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Glen Cove SD, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Glen Cove SD, N.Y.

text.p: at Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, 67 Wall Street, New York, New
Bonds dated June 15, 1997, interest March 15 and September 15 each year commencing March 15, 1998. Bonds mature in principal installments on September 15 as follows:

The District reserves the right to change the time and/or date of the bid opening, and notice thereof shall be provided at least 24 hours prior to the time set forth above and transmitted over the Munifacts wire.
Bids, accompanied by $50,000 good faith deposit check, must be for all $2,500,000 bonds. Award shall be based on lowest net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Evensen Dodge, Inc., 11 Penn Plaza, Fifth Floor, New York, New York 10001, telephone number (212) 946-2873; fax number (212) 946-2874.
President of the Board of Education
